portal.name: Brain Radiology FM Portal
portal.tagline: Open-weight 3D brain MRI, head CT, PET & fMRI foundation models, open-access neuroimaging datasets, and clinical benchmarks on one PACS bench.

verified_against.HF: Hugging Face model card & file listing
verified_against.Paper: Peer-reviewed publication or preprint (DOI / arXiv / medRxiv)

vol_enc.label: 3D Volumetric Encoders
vol_enc.blurb: Self-supervised 3D Vision Transformers and ResNets encoding structural T1w, multi-parametric MRI, and Head CT volumes into patient-level biomarkers and embeddings.

vlm.label: Neuro Vision–Language & Report FMs
vlm.blurb: Multimodal 3D/2D neuroradiology models for study-level diagnostic triage, zero-shot abnormality scoring, VQA, and structured MRI/CT report generation.

seg.label: 3D Parcellation & Lesion Segmentation
seg.blurb: Contrast-agnostic whole-brain anatomical parcellation, glioma/stroke lesion delineation, and 3D point/box-promptable volumetric segmenters.

morph.label: Synthesis, Registration & Multi-Task
morph.blurb: Cross-sequence MRI/CT translation (e.g. missing FLAIR synthesis), bias-field correction, and foundational 3D keypoint atlas registration.

fmri.label: 4D fMRI & Connectome FMs
fmri.blurb: Spatiotemporal and brain-graph foundation models decoding intrinsic functional networks and neurological/psychiatric states from BOLD fMRI.

embed_volumes.label: Embed 3D volumes
outputs: Cohort PCA scatter coloured by k-means cluster

report_vqa.label: Radiology report & VQA
outputs: Prompted clinical VQA answer & finding confidence bars

segment_brain.label: 3D Segment & volumetry
outputs: Interactive tri-planar segmentation overlay (Axial / Coronal / Sagittal)
Anatomical structure / lesion volume table (mm³ & % ICV)
3D label mask (.nii.gz) compatible with 3D Slicer & ITK-SNAP

synth_register.label: Synthesize / register 3D
outputs: Tri-planar synthesized target modality or MNI152-registered volume

decode_fmri.label: Decode fMRI networks
outputs: Intrinsic functional network activation profile (7 Yeo networks)

models.name: NeuroVFM Encoder
models.seq_hint: Any clinical Brain MRI sequence or Head CT study (NIfTI / DICOM)
models.notes: Pretrained via Volumetric Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (Vol-JEPA) on 5.24 million uncurated health-system Brain MRI and Head CT volumes.
models.citation: Kondepudi et al., Health system learning enables generalist neuroimaging models (NeuroVFM), Nature Medicine (2026)

models.name: Neuro-JEPA
models.seq_hint: Multimodal 3D Brain MRI (T1w, T2w, FLAIR; single- or multi-sequence)
models.notes: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts latent predictive 3D foundation model pretrained on >1.55M curated brain MRI scans (~428K studies) at NYU Langone across T1w, T2w, and FLAIR; benchmarked on 47 downstream tasks.
models.citation: Huang, Razavian et al., Learning Sparse Latent Predictive Foundation Model for Multimodal Neuroimaging (Neuro-JEPA), arXiv:2606.14957 (2026)

models.name: BrainFound (3D DINOv2 MRI)
models.seq_hint: Single- or multi-contrast 3D Brain MRI (T1w, T2w, FLAIR)
models.notes: Extends DINOv2 Vision Transformers to 3D brain anatomy across T1, T2, and FLAIR scans; strong label-efficient representations for disease classification, detection, and tumor/anatomical segmentation.
models.citation: Mazher, Parker & Alexander, Towards generalisable foundation models for brain MRI (BrainFound), npj Imaging (2026)

weights.note: Clone Moona-Mazher/BrainFound and set brainfound_ucl_ckpt in backend/config.yaml.

models.name: BrainIAC
models.seq_hint: 3D structural Brain MRI (T1w, T2w, FLAIR, T1ce)
models.notes: Trained on ~49,000 multi-institutional brain MRIs. Generalizes across BrainAge estimation, glioma IDH mutation status, MCI conversion risk, and stroke timing.
models.citation: Tak, Kann et al., A generalizable foundation model for analysis of human brain MRI (BrainIAC), Nature Neuroscience (2026)

models.name: Brain2Vec
models.seq_hint: 3D T1-weighted structural Brain MRI (MNI-aligned)
models.notes: Pretrained on 74,425 T1-weighted brain MRI scans across lifespan cohorts; extracts compact 768-d representations for BrainAge, neurodegeneration, and phenotype prediction.
models.citation: Maggioros, Erus, Davatzikos et al., Brain2Vec: A Self-Supervised 3D Foundation Model for Structural Brain MRI, arXiv:2610.28411 (2026)

models.name: NeuroFM
models.seq_hint: Single 3D T1-weighted Brain MRI
models.notes: Disease-naive 11M-parameter model runnable even on CPU; estimates individualized BrainAge, total brain volume, lateral ventricle volume, and biological sex from one T1w scan.
models.citation: Dibble, Svanera et al., NeuroFM: Toward Precision Neuroimaging with Foundation Models for Individualized Brain Health Estimation, medRxiv (2026)

models.name: BrainMVP
models.seq_hint: Multi-parametric Brain MRI (T1, T1ce, T2, FLAIR; missing-modality tolerant)
models.notes: CVPR Highlight model using cross-modal reconstruction and modality-aware contrastive pretraining to stay accurate when one or more mpMRI sequences are absent.
models.citation: Li et al., BrainMVP: Multi-modal Vision Pre-training for Medical Image Analysis, CVPR / arXiv:2410.10516 (2024)

weights.note: Download BrainMVP_pretrained.pt from the official GitHub release and set brainmvp_ckpt in config.yaml.

models.name: CT-FM (Cranial & Body 3D CT)
models.seq_hint: Non-contrast or contrast 3D Head / Cranial CT (Hounsfield Units)
models.notes: Pretrained via label-agnostic 3D contrastive learning on 148,000 CT volumes from the Imaging Data Commons; strong backbone for acute Head CT triage and case retrieval.
models.citation: Pai et al., Vision Foundation Models for Computed Tomography (CT-FM), arXiv:2501.09001 (2025)

models.name: NeuroVFM-LLM
models.seq_hint: Multi-series 3D Brain MRI or Head CT study + optional clinical history
models.notes: Generates grounded neuroradiology findings and answers clinical questions across multi-sequence Brain MRI and Head CT studies.
models.citation: Kondepudi et al., Health system learning enables generalist neuroimaging models (NeuroVFM), Nature Medicine (2026)

models.name: Brainfound (Multimodal CT/MRI/Text)
models.seq_hint: Brain MRI or Head CT slices/volumes + clinical prompt
models.notes: Multi-modal brain imaging copilot pretrained on >3M Head CT slices and >7M Brain MRI slices paired with radiology reports; unifies zero-shot disease diagnosis, report generation, VQA, and cross-modality enhancement/translation.
models.citation: Zhang, Dai et al., A multi-modal foundation model for brain disease diagnosis and medical imaging (Brainfound), Patterns (2026)

weights.note: Clone gingerbread000/Brainfound and set brainfound_mm_ckpt in backend/config.yaml.

models.name: NeuroVFM-Dx (Brain MRI)
models.seq_hint: Clinical Brain MRI study (T1w / T2w / FLAIR / DWI / SWI)
models.notes: Study-level multi-label diagnostic classifier for Brain MRI covering acute infarct, glioma/neoplasm, demyelination, hemorrhage, hydrocephalus, and infection.
models.citation: Kondepudi et al., Health system learning enables generalist neuroimaging models (NeuroVFM), Nature Medicine (2026)

models.name: NeuroVFM-Dx (Head CT)
models.seq_hint: Non-contrast / contrast Cranial CT study
models.notes: Urgent cranial CT diagnostic classifier scoring intracranial hemorrhage (SDH, EDH, SAH, IPH, IVH), mass effect, midline shift, acute ischemia, and skull fracture.
models.citation: Kondepudi et al., Health system learning enables generalist neuroimaging models (NeuroVFM), Nature Medicine (2026)

models.name: BrainGemma3D (Brain3D)
models.seq_hint: Native 3D Brain MRI volume (T1w / T1ce / T2w / FLAIR)
models.notes: Processes full 3D brain MRI volumes directly (avoiding 2D slice context loss) via an inflated 3D Vision Transformer aligned with Gemma for automated brain MRI report generation.
models.citation: Barone et al., Brain3D: Brain Report Automation via Inflated Vision Transformers in 3D, arXiv:2602.22098 (2026)

models.name: M3D-LaMed (Phi-3-4B)
models.seq_hint: 3D Brain MRI or Head CT volume (32×256×256)
models.notes: Trained on M3D-Data (120K 3D volumes & 662K instruction pairs). Supports 3D brain MRI & CT report generation, open-ended VQA, and zero-shot M3D-CLIP retrieval.
models.citation: Bai et al., M3D: Advancing 3D Medical Image Analysis with Multi-Modal Large Language Models, arXiv:2404.00578 (2024)

models.name: MedGemma-4B-IT
models.seq_hint: Multi-slice Brain MRI / Head CT montage or key axial/coronal/sagittal slices
models.notes: Open-weight medical multimodal VLM supporting interleaved Brain MRI and Head CT slice stacks, differential diagnosis VQA, and structured radiology reporting.
models.citation: Sellergren et al., MedGemma Technical Report, Google Health AI, arXiv:2507.05201 (2025)

models.name: RadFM
models.developer: Shanghai Jiao Tong Univ. & Shanghai AI Lab
models.seq_hint: 2D or 3D Brain MRI / Head CT / PET scans + clinical prompt
models.notes: Generalist 2D/3D radiology VLM pretrained on MedMD (16M scans across >5,000 diseases, with substantial neuroimaging coverage on RadBench).
models.citation: Wu et al., Towards Generalist Foundation Model for Radiology by Leveraging Web-scale 2D&3D Medical Data (RadFM), arXiv:2308.02463 (2023)

models.name: BiomedCLIP (Neuro Slice Zero-Shot)
models.seq_hint: 2D Brain MRI / CT / PET slices or central tri-planar projections
models.notes: Fast CPU/GPU zero-shot biomedical CLIP trained on PMC-15M. Ideal for rapid MRI sequence classification (T1 vs T2 vs FLAIR vs DWI vs CT) and slice-level lesion screening.
models.citation: Zhang et al., BiomedCLIP: a multimodal biomedical foundation model pretrained from fifteen million scientific image-text pairs, arXiv:2303.00915 (2023)

models.name: BrainSegFounder
models.seq_hint: 4-channel mpMRI (T1, T1ce, T2, FLAIR) or T1w stroke MRI
models.notes: Two-stage 3D self-supervised SwinUNETR pretrained on >41,000 UK Biobank brain MRIs with fine-tuned checkpoints for BraTS glioma sub-regions (WT, TC, ET) and ATLAS stroke lesions.
models.citation: Cox et al., BrainSegFounder: Towards 3D Foundation Models for Neuroimage Segmentation, Medical Image Analysis (2024)

models.name: SynthSeg 2.0
models.seq_hint: Any Brain MRI contrast (T1, T2, FLAIR, clinical thick-slice) or Head CT
models.notes: Contrast- and resolution-agnostic 3D whole-brain parcellation (32+ structures + cortical parcellation + automated QC score & intracranial volume) on clinical MRI or CT without retraining.
models.citation: Billot et al., SynthSeg: Segmentation of brain MRI scans of any contrast and resolution without retraining, Medical Image Analysis (2023)

weights.note: Bundled with FreeSurfer 7.4+ or clone BBillot/SynthSeg (set synthseg_repo in config.yaml).

models.name: FastSurferVINN
models.seq_hint: 3D T1-weighted Brain MRI (0.7–1.0 mm sub-millimeter supported)
models.notes: 95-class Desikan-Killiany-Tourville (DKT) whole-brain cortical & subcortical parcellation in under 1 minute on GPU, matching FreeSurfer morphometry.
models.citation: Henschel et al., FastSurferVINN: Building resolution-independence into deep learning segmentation methods, NeuroImage (2022)

weights.note: Install FastSurfer or Docker deepmi/fastsurfer; checkpoints auto-download on first run.

models.name: VISTA3D
models.seq_hint: 3D CT or Brain MRI volume (auto class ID or 3D click prompt)
models.notes: Unified 3D foundation segmenter combining automatic multi-structure segmentation with interactive zero-shot 3D point prompting for novel lesions.
models.citation: He et al., VISTA3D: A Unified Segmentation Foundation Model For 3D Medical Imaging, arXiv:2406.05285 (2024)

models.name: nnInteractive
models.seq_hint: Any 3D Brain MRI, Head CT, or PET volume + point / box / scribble prompt
models.notes: True 3D promptable open-set segmentation trained on 120+ volumetric datasets across MRI, CT, and PET. Excels at brain tumors, metastases, aneurysms, and edema from a single 3D click or box.
models.citation: Isensee et al., nnInteractive: Redefining 3D Promptable Segmentation, arXiv:2503.08373 (2025)

models.name: MedSAM2
models.developer: Univ. of Toronto / UHN (Bo Wang Lab)
models.seq_hint: 3D Brain MRI or Head CT treated as slice-propagated volume
models.notes: Adapts SAM 2 memory-attention propagation to 3D medical volumes; prompt one central brain slice and propagate lesion contours through the entire NIfTI stack.
models.citation: Zhu, Ma, Wang et al., Medical SAM 2: Segment medical images as video via Segment Anything Model 2, arXiv:2408.03322 (2024)

models.name: TotalSegmentator (Brain MRI & CT)
models.seq_hint: 3D Brain/Head MRI or Cranial CT (NIfTI)
models.notes: Turnkey `pip install TotalSegmentator` CLI & Python library with dedicated `brain_structures`, `ventricle_parts`, and `total_mr` sub-tasks.
models.citation: Wasserthal et al. / Akinci D'Antonoli et al., TotalSegmentator CT & MRI: Robust Segmentation of Anatomical Structures, Radiology: AI (2023 / 2024)

weights.note: pip install TotalSegmentator — weights download automatically into ~/.totalsegmentator on first run.

models.name: BrainFM (Modality-Agnostic)
models.seq_hint: Any 3D Brain MRI (T1w, T2w, FLAIR) or Head CT
models.notes: Single modality-agnostic foundation model handling cross-modality brain synthesis (T1w ↔ T2w ↔ FLAIR ↔ CT), bias-field estimation, registration, and cortical distance mapping.
models.citation: Liu et al., BrainFM: A Modality-agnostic Multi-task Foundation Model for Human Brain Imaging, arXiv:2509.00549 (2025)

weights.note: Clone jhuldr/BrainFM and download pretrained multi-task checkpoint per its README (set brainfm_repo in config.yaml).

models.name: BrainMorph
models.seq_hint: Moving & fixed 3D Brain MRI (or register to MNI152 template)
models.notes: Foundational 3D keypoint registration model trained on >100,000 normal and lesioned brain MRIs; supports rigid, affine, and diffeomorphic nonlinear alignment in milliseconds.
models.citation: Wang et al., BrainMorph: A Foundational Keypoint Model for Robust and Flexible Brain MRI Registration, MELBA (2025)

weights.note: Clone alanqrwang/brainmorph and place keypoint weights in backend/external/brainmorph.

models.name: BrainLM (650M)
models.seq_hint: Parcellated 4D resting-state or task fMRI timeseries (AAL-424 parcels)
models.notes: Trained on 6,700 hours of UK Biobank & HCP 4D fMRI recordings via masked spatio-temporal prediction; decodes intrinsic networks, future brain states, and cognitive phenotypes.
models.citation: Ortega Caro, Fonseca, van Dijk et al., BrainLM: A foundation model for brain activity recordings, ICLR / bioRxiv (2024)

models.name: BrainGFM
models.seq_hint: Functional connectivity graph or parcellated BOLD fMRI across any brain atlas
models.notes: Pretrained across diverse anatomical and functional brain atlases with meta-learned graph prompts and text disorder descriptions for cross-atlas connectome diagnosis.
models.citation: Xu et al., A Brain Graph Foundation Model: Pre-Training and Prompt-Tuning across Broad Atlases and Disorders, arXiv:2506.02044 (2025)

weights.note: Clone weixinxu666/BrainGFM and set braingfm_ckpt in backend/config.yaml.

datasets.name: BraTS (Glioma, Meningioma, Mets & SSA)
datasets.annotations: Expert-refined 3D tumor sub-region masks (Whole Tumor, Tumor Core, Enhancing Tumor / Resection Cavity), post-treatment glioma, meningioma, brain metastases, pediatric & Sub-Saharan Africa cohorts
datasets.cli_hint:
pip install synapseclient
synapse get -r syn51156910   # BraTS 2023/2024 Adult Glioma (after Synapse DUA)

datasets.name: UCSF-PDGM (Preoperative Diffuse Glioma MRI)
datasets.annotations: Standardized 3T 3D preoperative mpMRI (T1, T1ce, T2, FLAIR, SWI, DWI, ASL, HARDI) with expert-refined 3D tumor compartment masks, WHO Grade II–IV, IDH mutation, MGMT methylation, 1p/19q codeletion & overall survival
datasets.cli_hint:
pip install idc-index
idc-index download --collection ucsf_pdgm

datasets.name: UPenn-GBM (Glioblastoma Multi-Parametric MRI)
datasets.annotations: Pre- and post-operative structural mpMRI, DSC perfusion & DTI scans with automated/manually corrected 3D tumor sub-region masks, clinical outcomes, overall survival, MGMT/IDH status & precomputed CaPTk radiomics
datasets.cli_hint:
pip install idc-index
idc-index download --collection upenn_gbm

datasets.name: LUMIERE (Longitudinal Glioblastoma RANO MRI)
datasets.annotations: Multi-timepoint post-operative glioblastoma follow-up MRI (T1, T1ce, T2, FLAIR) with expert neuroradiologist RANO response ratings (CR, PR, SD, PD), HD-GLIO/DeepBraTumIA masks, MGMT/IDH pathology & survival
datasets.cli_hint:
# Download directly from Figshare collection DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.c.5904905
curl -L https://api.figshare.com/v2/collections/5904905/articles

datasets.name: RSNA Intracranial Hemorrhage (ICH) CT
datasets.annotations: Multi-institutional RSNA/ASNR neuroradiologist labels across 5 acute hemorrhage subtypes (epidural, intraparenchymal, intraventricular, subarachnoid, subdural) plus any-ICH indicator
datasets.cli_hint:
pip install kaggle
kaggle competitions download -c rsna-intracranial-hemorrhage-detection

datasets.name: CQ500 (Emergency Non-Contrast Head CT)
datasets.annotations: Independent 3-radiologist consensus reads for intracranial hemorrhage (IPH, IVH, SDH, EDH, SAH), calvarial fracture, midline shift (>5 mm) & mass effect across multi-center clinical scanners
datasets.cli_hint:
# Download DICOM zip archives & reads.csv directly from headctstudy.qure.ai/dataset
# Convert to NIfTI with: dcm2niix -z y -ba y -o ./cq500_nii ./cq500_dcm

datasets.name: ISLES 2022 (Acute Ischemic Stroke MRI)
datasets.annotations: 250 public training & 150 hidden test acute/subacute ischemic stroke studies (DWI, ADC, FLAIR) with voxel-accurate 3D infarct core segmentations spanning small embolic and large-vessel occlusions
datasets.cli_hint:
pip install zenodo_get
zenodo_get 7153326   # ISLES 2022 multi-center DWI/ADC/FLAIR BIDS archive

datasets.name: ATLAS v2.0 (Chronic Stroke T1w Lesions)
datasets.annotations: 655 public training, 300 hidden test & 316 generalizability T1-weighted chronic stroke brain MRIs with manually traced 3D lesion masks harmonized in MNI space by the ENIGMA Stroke Recovery consortium
datasets.cli_hint:
# Register at INDI/NITRC (ATLAS R2.0) or join https://atlas.grand-challenge.org/
# Distributed in standard BIDS layout (sub-rXXXsXXX/ses-1/anat/)

datasets.name: ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative)
datasets.annotations: Longitudinal structural T1w/FLAIR MRI, Amyloid/Tau/FDG PET, CSF/plasma biomarkers, APOE genotype, MMSE/CDR-SB scores & clinical diagnosis (CN, EMCI, LMCI, AD) for conversion modeling
datasets.cli_hint:
# Apply for LONI IDA access at https://ida.loni.usc.edu/
# Convert ADNI to BIDS with: clinica convert adni-to-bids ./ADNI ./clinical ./BIDS

datasets.name: OASIS-3 & OASIS-4 (Longitudinal Aging MRI/PET)
datasets.annotations: 30-year longitudinal cohort spanning cognitively normal aging and Alzheimer's dementia from WUSTL Knight ADRC with T1w, T2w, FLAIR, ASL, SWI, rs-fMRI, PIB/AV45/Tau PET & CDR clinical staging
datasets.cli_hint:
# Sign OASIS DUA at https://sites.wustl.edu/oasisbrains/
# Batch fetch via official oasis-scripts (github.com/NrgXnat/oasis-scripts)

datasets.name: UK Biobank Brain Imaging
datasets.annotations: Population-scale harmonized 3T neuroimaging (T1w, T2-FLAIR, SWI, multi-shell dMRI, resting & task 4D fMRI) linked to EHR, genetics & cognitive phenotypes — pretraining backbone for BrainSegFounder, BrainLM & Brain2Vec
datasets.cli_hint:
# Access via UK Biobank Research Analysis Platform (RAP / DNAnexus)
dx download '/Bulk/Brain MRI/T1/*'   # approved UKB research project

datasets.name: Mindboggle-101 & IXI (DKT & Lifespan T1w)
datasets.annotations: Gold-standard manually edited Desikan-Killiany-Tourville (DKT) cortical & subcortical anatomical labels (Mindboggle-101) paired with ~600 healthy multi-site T1/T2/PD/MRA/DTI scans across ages 20–86 (IXI)
datasets.cli_hint:
# Mindboggle-101 on OSF (osf.io/nhtur) & IXI T1w tarball:
curl -LO http://biomedic.doc.ic.ac.uk/brain-development/downloads/IXI/IXI-T1.tar

datasets.name: FOMO-MRI (FOMO60K / FOMO260K Suite)
datasets.annotations: Standardized multi-center open pretraining corpus (T1, T2, FLAIR, DWI, ADC across healthy & pathological brains) plus MICCAI FOMO few-shot clinical benchmark tasks (infarct, meningioma, aneurysm, age)

datasets.name: M3D-Data & M3D-VQA (3D Medical VLM Corpus)
datasets.annotations: Large-scale 3D multi-modal CT & MRI image-text pairs, structured radiology descriptions, closed/open VQA instruction pairs, and referring lesion segmentation masks with extensive brain MRI/CT subsets

datasets.name: fastMRI Brain & fastMRI+ (NYU Clinical MRI)
datasets.annotations: Fully sampled clinical multi-coil k-space & DICOM brain MRIs (T1, T1ce, T2, FLAIR) from NYU Langone augmented by fastMRI+ with 7,570 subspecialist pathology bounding boxes across 30 neurological categories
datasets.cli_hint:
# Request fastMRI Brain download links at https://fastmri.med.nyu.edu/
git clone https://github.com/microsoft/fastmri-plus.git   # 7,570 brain pathology labels

datasets.name: Human Connectome Project (HCP-YA & Lifespan)
datasets.annotations: High-resolution 0.7 mm isotropic T1w/T2w structural MRI, 3T/7T 4D resting-state & 7-domain task fMRI (TR=0.72 s), multi-shell diffusion tractography, Glasser MMP-360 parcellations & behavioral batteries
datasets.license: HCP Open Access Data Use Terms
datasets.cli_hint:
# Open-access AWS S3 bucket (s3://hcp-openaccess) with ConnectomeDB credentials
aws s3 ls s3://hcp-openaccess/HCP_1200/

datasets.name: OpenNeuro (Open BIDS Neuroimaging Archive)
datasets.annotations: Largest public Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) repository hosting curated structural MRI, resting/task 4D fMRI, DWI, and brain PET datasets with individual DOIs and zero-registration S3/DataLad access
datasets.cli_hint:
pip install openneuro-py
openneuro-py download --dataset=ds000228 --target-dir=./ds000228   # or aws s3 sync --no-sign-request

datasets.name: ABIDE I & II (Multi-Site Resting-State fMRI)
datasets.annotations: Multi-site resting-state 4D BOLD fMRI and T1w structural MRI spanning Autism Spectrum Disorder and neurotypical controls with preprocessed Schaefer/AAL/CC200 ROI timeseries for BrainGFM & BrainLM benchmarks

benchmarks.name: BraTS Adult Glioma 3D Segmentation
benchmarks.scope: Gold-standard 3D brain tumor sub-region segmentation & radiogenomic (IDH / MGMT) benchmark
benchmarks.description: 3D volumetric overlap across Whole Tumor (WT), Tumor Core (TC), and Enhancing Tumor (ET) on multi-institutional preoperative and post-treatment diffuse glioma MRI.

benchmarks.name: Acute Head CT Triage & ICH Detection
benchmarks.cohort: Health-System Emergency Head CT, CQ500 (n=491) & RSNA ICH (n=25,312)
benchmarks.scope: Emergency cranial CT hemorrhage (EDH, SDH, SAH, IPH, IVH), midline shift, mass effect & acute ischemia triage
benchmarks.description: Study-level diagnostic discrimination across critical non-contrast cranial CT emergencies including intracranial hemorrhage subtypes, mass effect, and acute stroke.

entries.secondary: Mean AUROC across clinical CT endpoints

benchmarks.name: Whole-Brain 3D Anatomical Parcellation
benchmarks.cohort: Mindboggle-101 (DKT), HCP Sub-mm (0.7–1.0 mm) & Multi-Contrast Clinical Scans
benchmarks.scope: Subcortical and cortical 3D whole-brain parcellation across isotropic research MRI, thick-slice clinical MRI, and cranial CT
benchmarks.description: Anatomical accuracy across 32–95 cortical and subcortical brain compartments comparing dedicated T1w parcellators against domain-randomized contrast-agnostic models.

benchmarks.name: Lifespan BrainAge Estimation (OpenBHB / Multi-Cohort)
benchmarks.cohort: OpenBHB (n=757 test), UK Biobank & Multi-Cohort Lifespan T1w MRI
benchmarks.scope: Individualized structural BrainAge regression and Brain-Age Gap (BAG) biomarker estimation across multi-site scanners
benchmarks.description: Mean Absolute Error (lower is better) predicting biological brain age from structural 3D MRI to quantify accelerated neurodegeneration via Brain-Age Gap (BAG).

benchmarks.name: Clinical Brain MRI Diagnosis & Neurodegeneration
benchmarks.cohort: ADNI (CN vs. AD / MCI), Clinical MRI Ontologies & UCSF-PDGM Molecular Subtyping
benchmarks.scope: Multi-disease clinical brain MRI classification, Alzheimer's / MCI progression, and glioma molecular subtyping
benchmarks.description: Diagnostic AUROC evaluating frozen 3D volumetric foundation embeddings and clinical MRI heads across neurodegenerative, neoplastic, and neurovascular endpoints.

entries.secondary: Mean clinical Brain MRI ontology AUROC
ADNI CN vs. AD transfer (npj Imaging)

benchmarks.name: Stroke Lesion 3D Segmentation (ATLAS v2.0 & ISLES)
benchmarks.cohort: ATLAS v2.0 Chronic T1w (n=1,271) & ISLES 2022 Acute DWI/FLAIR (n=400)
benchmarks.scope: Chronic T1w and acute DWI/FLAIR ischemic stroke infarct segmentation across multi-center scanners
benchmarks.description: Volumetric segmentation overlap on heterogeneous acute and chronic ischemic stroke lesions comparing automatic SSL transfer against interactive 3D foundation prompters.

benchmarks.name: 3D Neuroradiology Reporting & Clinical VQA
benchmarks.cohort: BraTS Clinical Report Entities, M3D-VQA (662K pairs) & Health-System Studies
benchmarks.scope: Automated 3D brain MRI & head CT report generation, pathology entity fidelity, laterality, and closed/open clinical VQA
benchmarks.description: Evaluation of 3D and multi-slice neuroradiology VLMs on clinical pathology recognition F1, structured report grounding, and M3D-VQA accuracy.

benchmarks.name: 4D fMRI Brain-State & Cross-Atlas Decoding
benchmarks.cohort: UK Biobank (6,700 h BOLD), HCP, ABIDE II (ASD) & ADNI-fMRI
benchmarks.scope: Zero/few-shot cross-atlas connectome disorder classification and self-supervised 4D BOLD parcel state reconstruction
benchmarks.description: Evaluates 4D spatiotemporal fMRI transformers and cross-atlas brain-graph foundation models on connectome disorder decoding and masked parcel dynamics.

ecosystem.name: Project MONAI & Model Zoo
ecosystem.description: PyTorch-native toolkit powering NIfTI/DICOM volumetric transforms, sliding-window 3D inference, SwinUNETR, SegResNet, and VISTA3D bundles.

ecosystem.name: FreeSurfer 8, SynthSeg & SynthMorph
ecosystem.description: MGH Martinos neuroimaging suite bundling SynthSeg 2.0, SynthStrip (skull-stripping FM), SynthSR (clinical super-resolution), and SynthMorph.

ecosystem.name: NCI Imaging Data Commons (IDC) & TCIA
ecosystem.description: Cloud-hosted DICOM/NIfTI access to UCSF-PDGM, UPenn-GBM, BraTS legacy cohorts, and multi-parametric glioma collections via `idc-index`.

ecosystem.name: BIDS, OpenNeuro & NiBabel
ecosystem.description: Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) standard, Python NIfTI I/O (`nibabel`), `dcm2niix` PHI-stripping conversion, and OpenNeuro S3/DataLad CLI.

ecosystem.name: WHO CNS5 & RANO 2.0 / RANO-Resect
ecosystem.description: Integrated molecular glioma classification (IDH, 1p/19q, MGMT) and standardized longitudinal volumetric tumor response criteria.

ecosystem.name: 3D Slicer, ITK-SNAP & Hugging Face Hub
ecosystem.description: Open-source 3D workstation viewers for `.nii.gz` masks exported by this portal alongside Hugging Face open-weight checkpoint hosting.

literature_references.name: Med-Gemini-3D / Med-PaLM M
literature_references.scope: Large proprietary multimodal medical foundation models supporting 3D Head CT report generation & generalist radiology VQA (closed weights — benchmark reference; see open-weight MedGemma above)

literature_references.name: MONAI & MONAI Model Zoo
literature_references.scope: PyTorch-based open-source framework powering NIfTI/DICOM volumetric transforms, sliding-window 3D inference, SwinUNETR, SegResNet, and VISTA3D

literature_references.name: FreeSurfer 8 & SynthMorph
literature_references.scope: Reference neuroimaging suite integrating SynthSeg, SynthStrip (skull-stripping FM), SynthSR (clinical MRI super-resolution), and SynthMorph

literature_references.name: BIDS, NiBabel & 3D Slicer
literature_references.scope: Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) standard, NIfTI Python I/O (`nibabel`), and interactive desktop 3D visualization for `.nii.gz` masks exported by this portal

hardware_rules.source: Portal rule of thumb based on 3D volume activations + FP16/BF16 model weights. Replaced by measured speed & peak VRAM once a model runs on your server.

tiers.label: CPU / 6 GB GPU
tiers.cpu: Runs on CPU for single 3D NIfTI volumes (~10–45 s); fast on any 6+ GB GPU.

tiers.label: 8–12 GB GPU
tiers.cpu: Runs on CPU slowly for single scans; an 8–12 GB CUDA GPU is recommended for 3D sliding-window inference.

tiers.label: 16–24 GB GPU
tiers.cpu: Multimodal 4B–7B 3D VLM; use a 16–24 GB GPU (RTX 4090, L4, A10G) or 4-bit quantization.

tiers.label: 24–48+ GB GPU
tiers.cpu: Large 3D radiology VLM; requires a 24–48+ GB GPU (A6000, L40S, A100) or vLLM tensor parallelism.
